author: ahnyoung-paul
title: GPU MSDAOpt build fails with 'must use struct tag' for ov::layout vs ::layout name clash
signature: error: must use 'struct' tag to refer to type 'layout' in this scope; struct 'layout' is hidden by a non-type declaration of 'layout' (namespace ov::layout in core/layout.hpp) when compiling intel_gpu ocl_v2/msda_opt.hpp lambda parameters const layout& l|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake - build OpenVINO step fails compiling src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/registry/msda_impls.cpp (via msda_opt.hpp) with clang errors about 'layout' name lookup

failed_jobs.name: Build x64
failed_jobs.symptom: Identical msda_opt.hpp compile failure as Build arm64, same two errors at lines 38 and 41

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_android
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status gate fails because the arm64/x64 build jobs it depends on failed

key_errors: /__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl_v2/msda_opt.hpp:38:37: error: must use 'struct' tag to refer to type 'layout' in this scope
/__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/core/include/openvino/core/layout.hpp:109:11: note: struct 'layout' is hidden by a non-type declaration of 'layout' here
/__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl_v2/msda_opt.hpp:41:42: error: must use 'struct' tag to refer to type 'layout' in this scope
root_cause: The new file src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl_v2/msda_opt.hpp (added by PR #37749, 'Support ShapeOf derived MHA Broadcast and Reshape', merged just before this queue run at commit fde316cf) has `using namespace cldnn;` at file scope and then declares lambdas with parameter type `const layout& l`. cldnn::layout is a struct, but `openvino/core/layout.hpp` (included transitively) also declares a namespace `ov::layout` that is pulled in via `using namespace ov;`/ADL in the same translation unit, so plain `layout` becomes ambiguous between the struct and the namespace; clang requires an explicit `struct layout` tag to disambiguate in that scope. This bug is pre-existing in the newly merged ocl_v2/msda_opt.hpp and is unrelated to the content of PR #38701 (GPU VariableState::set_state() optimization), whose changed files do not touch msda_opt.hpp/msda_impls.cpp at all. The merge-queue run for #38701 simply rebuilds on top of the already-broken master HEAD (fde316cf), so both the arm64 and x64 Android builds fail identically regardless of #38701's own changes.
reproduction_steps:
1. Checkout commit fde316cf48b371dd495e2e0ce840056a6f8a8356 (or later, until fixed) on master.
2. Configure an Android (NDK clang) build of OpenVINO with ENABLE_CM_FOR_GPU, as the CI 'Build arm64'/'Build x64' Android jobs do.
3. Run `ninja openvino_intel_gpu_graph` (or the full build).
4. Observe the same two 'must use struct tag' errors compiling src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/registry/msda_impls.cpp via msda_opt.hpp.
recommended_actions: In src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl_v2/msda_opt.hpp, qualify the lambda parameter types explicitly as `struct layout` (i.e. `[](const struct layout& l)`) at lines 38 and 41, or better, use `const cldnn::layout&` explicitly and drop the broad `using namespace cldnn;` reliance for this symbol.

Audit other new files under src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl_v2/ introduced by PR #37749 for the same `using namespace cldnn;` + bare `layout` pattern, since cldnn::layout vs ov::layout (namespace) collisions can recur wherever both headers are visible.

Re-run the failed CMake/ninja build jobs on the merge-queue run once the fix lands on master; this is unrelated to PR #38701 itself, so #38701 can be safely re-added to the queue after the fix merges.
prevention_strategies: Add a CI/code-review check (or clang-tidy rule) flagging bare un-prefixed `layout` identifiers in intel_gpu ocl_v2/ files that rely on `using namespace cldnn;`, since ov::layout (a namespace) and cldnn::layout (a struct) share the same unqualified name and silently compile on compilers/flag combinations that don't hit the ambiguity, making it easy to miss in local x86/Linux clang builds that behave differently from the Android NDK clang toolchain used in CI.
historical_context: No prior occurrence of this specific 'layout' name-clash signature found in the pattern database (first occurrence). The bug was introduced by PR #37749 merged just before this run (commit fde316cf) and is unrelated to the PR (#38701) that triggered this merge-queue run.
